你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

Action: {"name":"工具名称","args":{参数对象}}

Thought: 任务已完成

参数或调用注定失败的工具；请在 Thought 中明确说明无法执行的原因，再用
Action: FINISH 结束。此时不要声称任务已经完成。
注意：只能使用上面列出的工具。每次只能执行一个动作。
强约束：
- Action 后必须是“严格 JSON”(双引号、true/false/null, 小写)
- 禁止 Python 风格 True/False/None
- 禁止尾随逗号、注释、以及任何额外文本
关于“指代上一条操作的论文”：
- 当用户没有给出明确的论文序号/ID/标题，但你判断用户是在指代“最近一次操作过的那篇论文”（例如上下文中的指代性表达），
  则在调用需要论文引用的工具时，把 args 里的 ref 设置为 null(JSON null), 由工具自动定位最近操作的论文。
- 如果用户给出了明确序号/ID/标题，则正常传 ref。
关于异步任务（翻译）：
- translate_arxiv_pdf 是异步任务，调用后会立即返回 task_id 和 PENDING 状态。
- 翻译进度由前端通过 SSE 实时推送，你不需要也不应该轮询检查翻译状态。
- 调用 translate_arxiv_pdf 之后，直接 FINISH 即可，不要再调用 get_paper_cache_status 去查看翻译是否完成。

Decoding the Past: An Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning Framework for Sex Attribution in Prehistoric Hand Stencils

Abstract
Determining the biological sex of the individuals who created Upper Paleolithic hand stencils remains a chal-
lenging problem due to the absence of ground truth, population differences between contemporary and pre-
historic groups, and the uncertainty introduced by image degradation. Traditional morphometric methods
suffer from high structural overlap across sexes, poor cross-population generalizability, and subjective feature2026 engineering. This study presents an uncertainty-aware deep learning framework for sex attribution in prehis-
toric hand stencils that explicitly models, propagates, and aggregates uncertainty throughout the analytical
pipeline. The methodology combines dual image processing, dual contour extraction, structured silhouetteAug augmentation, model architectural diversity, and ensemble-based decision aggregation. The pipeline generates
twelve plausible silhouette realizations per stencil to capture boundary uncertainties, which are processed by14
two ensembles of ten deep neural networks each (EfficientNet-B3 and MobileViT-S) trained on 14,036 con-
temporary hand samples. Furthermore, a triangulated validation scheme integrates ensemble predictions with
unsupervised 2D latent-space manifold mapping (UMAP + k-NN) and explainable AI spatial attributions
(LayerCAM) to ensure anatomical consistency. On contemporary data, ensemble models achieve strong classi-
fication performance, with accuracies exceeding 88% in older age groups. When applied to prehistoric stencils,[cs.CV]the framework produces both sex predictions and confidence measures of internal agreement, enabling the
distinction between morphologically stable and ambiguous cases. The convergence observed across ensemble
predictions, latent-space structure, and interpretability analyses suggests that uncertainty can be transformed
into an explicit and measurable component of archaeological inference, providing a robust, transparent, and
reproducible approach to decoding ancient rock art.

management, explainable AI

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

参数或调用注定失败的工具；请在 Thought 中明确说明无法执行的原因，再用
Action: FINISH 结束。此时不要声称任务已经完成。
注意：只能使用上面列出的工具。每次只能执行一个动作。
强约束：
- Action 后必须是“严格 JSON”(双引号、true/false/null, 小写)
- 禁止 Python 风格 True/False/None
- 禁止尾随逗号、注释、以及任何额外文本
关于“指代上一条操作的论文”：
- 当用户没有给出明确的论文序号/ID/标题，但你判断用户是在指代“最近一次操作过的那篇论文”（例如上下文中的指代性表达），
  则在调用需要论文引用的工具时，把 args 里的 ref 设置为 null(JSON null), 由工具自动定位最近操作的论文。
- 如果用户给出了明确序号/ID/标题，则正常传 ref。
关于异步任务（翻译）：
- translate_arxiv_pdf 是异步任务，调用后会立即返回 task_id 和 PENDING 状态。
- 翻译进度由前端通过 SSE 实时推送，你不需要也不应该轮询检查翻译状态。
- 调用 translate_arxiv_pdf 之后，直接 FINISH 即可，不要再调用 get_paper_cache_status 去查看翻译是否完成。

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing

    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

Action: FINISH 结束。此时不要声称任务已经完成。
注意：只能使用上面列出的工具。每次只能执行一个动作。
强约束：
- Action 后必须是“严格 JSON”(双引号、true/false/null, 小写)
- 禁止 Python 风格 True/False/None
- 禁止尾随逗号、注释、以及任何额外文本
关于“指代上一条操作的论文”：
- 当用户没有给出明确的论文序号/ID/标题，但你判断用户是在指代“最近一次操作过的那篇论文”（例如上下文中的指代性表达），
  则在调用需要论文引用的工具时，把 args 里的 ref 设置为 null(JSON null), 由工具自动定位最近操作的论文。
- 如果用户给出了明确序号/ID/标题，则正常传 ref。
关于异步任务（翻译）：
- translate_arxiv_pdf 是异步任务，调用后会立即返回 task_id 和 PENDING 状态。
- 翻译进度由前端通过 SSE 实时推送，你不需要也不应该轮询检查翻译状态。
- 调用 translate_arxiv_pdf 之后，直接 FINISH 即可，不要再调用 get_paper_cache_status 去查看翻译是否完成。

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a bullet summary in at most 60 words.

The summary must be 3-5 bullet points, each starting with '- '.

Paper content:
Critical-State RL: Diagnosing Trainable States for Multi-Turn Tool Use

Abstract
Multi-turn tool-use failures can hinge on a single model call, yet reward variation alone Sep does not reveal which call would benefit from training. When rewards depend on later interactions, their variation can reflect downstream randomness rather than differences 21 between the current actions. We introduce Critical-State RL to identify trainable states in multi-turn interactions. Given task-defined candidate calls and local rewards, the method assesses whether each reward captures the action’s effect on task success and whether improvement over a reference policy is possible. It then uses nested sampling to separate action-dependent reward variation from continuation noise and optimizes the policy at the selected states using contextual-bandit training. Experiments on the Berkeley Function[cs.LG] Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) v4 compare training at diagnostic-selected states with training at alternative states. For missing-function tasks, the diagnostic selects the response after the tool becomes available; for missing-argument tasks, it selects the response before the missing argument is supplied. Training the selected responses improves performance, including about 14 percentage points on the missing-function task, while training the alternatives leaves performance flat or worse. We further apply the recipe across models and tasks, including logged repeat-call avoidance and memory management.

Write only the summary.

- Introduces Critical-State RL to identify trainable states in multi-turn tool use by separating action effects from downstream noise.
- Uses nested sampling and contextual-bandit training to optimize policies at diagnostic-selected states.
- Achieves a 14-point performance gain on missing-function tasks by training at the correct critical state.
- Demonstrates that training at alternative states yields flat or worse results compared to diagnostic-selected states.

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10

  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a bullet summary in at most 250 words.

The summary must be 3-5 bullet points, each starting with '- '.

Paper content:
CPI-Bench: A Comprehensive,Practical and Intelligent Benchmark for Real-World Image Editing

Abstract
With the rapid advancement of image editing models and their widespread application
across various domains, there is an increasingly urgent need to deploy these model
capabilities directly into real-world scenarios. However, existing benchmarks remain
confined to simple single-image tasks, suffering from limited coverage dimensions
and an inability to effectively differentiate performance among diverse models. Con-
sequently, they fail to reliably evaluate model performance in complex multi-image2026
editing, highly demanding reasoning instructions, and practical deployment settings.
To address these limitations, we propose CPI-Bench, a Comprehensive, Practical and
Intelligent benchmark for real-world image editing. CPI-Bench comprises three coreAug subsets: CPI-General-Bench, which comprehensively covers diverse editing tasks and
pioneers the inclusion of multi-image editing evaluation; CPI-Practical-Bench, which
14 focuses on high-frequency real-user application scenarios; and CPI-Intelligent-Bench,
which is dedicated to evaluating capabilities in highly demanding reasoning-based
editing. Evaluation results of mainstream image editing models based on CPI-Bench
demonstrate that CPI-Bench enhances performance differentiation among models. It
provides a comprehensive and reliable quantification of gaps in general editing capa-
bilities, practical deployment efficacy, and advanced reasoning-based editing, offering
invaluable guidance for the future optimization of image editing models. Crucially,[cs.CV] our ranking analysis reveals that CPI-Bench achieves the highest alignment with the
Arena Image Edit Leaderboard, indicating it faithfully captures the preferences and
perceptual judgments of human evaluators, serving as a robust proxy for real-world user
experience.

board [6]. CPI-Bench we proposed demonstrates the closest alignment with Arena. Right: Spearman
correlation coefficients and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) with Arena rank. CPI-Bench outperforms other
benchmarks, achieving the highest correlation and the lowest error margin.

- Introduces CPI-Bench, a comprehensive, practical, and intelligent benchmark designed to evaluate real-world image editing models, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks that focus solely on simple single-image tasks and fail to differentiate model performance in complex scenarios.
- Comprises three core subsets: CPI-General-Bench, which pioneers multi-image editing evaluation and covers diverse fundamental tasks; CPI-Practical-Bench, which targets high-frequency real-user application scenarios such as ad creation and product retouching; and CPI-Intelligent-Bench, which assesses capabilities in highly demanding, reasoning-based editing tasks across various domains.

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

## Problem Statement
Traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems score retrieved passages independently against a query, ignoring structural dependencies among chunks. This approach often assembles top-k results as individually relevant but collectively incoherent fragments. For instance, a query about Type 2 diabetes treatment might retrieve contradictory or temporally fragmented passages (e.g., outdated insulin advice alongside newer GLP-1 data and unrelated Type 1 diabetes information). These individually high-scoring chunks can form a misleading context that actively harms the generator’s output, a failure mode frequently observed when hard distractors outscore gold supporting chunks on individual relevance metrics.

## Proposed Method
The authors introduce Coherence-Aware Graph Encoding (CAGE), a reranking framework designed to model "between-chunk coherence." CAGE transforms retrieved passages into directed heterogeneous entity graphs to capture structural relationships. It amplifies factual anchors using min-out-degree reweighting and encodes structural patterns via a Relational Graph Convolutional Network. The framework evaluates coherence across four dimensions: Intra-Domain Relevance, Noise Resistance, Informational Bonding, and Factual Consistency. Finally, CAGE fuses these inter-chunk coherence signals with standard query relevance scores to produce a final ranking that prioritizes structurally coherent evidence over isolated high-scoring fragments.

## Evaluation and Results
CAGE was evaluated across four multi-hop benchmarks. The results demonstrate that structurally coherent context yields more precise answers, even when retrieval recall is comparable to or lower than baseline methods. Specifically, CAGE matches or outperforms strong baselines, including monoT5, in Recall@5 on bridge-dominated datasets. Furthermore, the framework consistently improves downstream Exact Match scores, validating the hypothesis that modeling collective coherence among retrieved chunks is critical for enhancing RAG system performance.

    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

Thought: 任务已完成

参数或调用注定失败的工具；请在 Thought 中明确说明无法执行的原因，再用
Action: FINISH 结束。此时不要声称任务已经完成。
注意：只能使用上面列出的工具。每次只能执行一个动作。
强约束：
- Action 后必须是“严格 JSON”(双引号、true/false/null, 小写)
- 禁止 Python 风格 True/False/None
- 禁止尾随逗号、注释、以及任何额外文本
关于“指代上一条操作的论文”：
- 当用户没有给出明确的论文序号/ID/标题，但你判断用户是在指代“最近一次操作过的那篇论文”（例如上下文中的指代性表达），
  则在调用需要论文引用的工具时，把 args 里的 ref 设置为 null(JSON null), 由工具自动定位最近操作的论文。
- 如果用户给出了明确序号/ID/标题，则正常传 ref。
关于异步任务（翻译）：
- translate_arxiv_pdf 是异步任务，调用后会立即返回 task_id 和 PENDING 状态。
- 翻译进度由前端通过 SSE 实时推送，你不需要也不应该轮询检查翻译状态。
- 调用 translate_arxiv_pdf 之后，直接 FINISH 即可，不要再调用 get_paper_cache_status 去查看翻译是否完成。

CAST: Collision-Aware Assembly with Construction Robots using Simultaneous Trajectory Estimation and Planning

Abstract
Multi-robot systems have shown increasing via- bility in construction due to their ability to execute high- precision actions while reducing human exposure to hazardous tasks. However, these environments have high-dimensional con- figuration spaces and possess substantial collision-avoidance constraints, which include other robots, assembly objects, and workspace boundaries. We utilize a single factor graph for trajectory estimation and planning that incorporates measured robot states together with explicit collision and learned cable2026 constraints. This supports changing workspaces and enables synchronized, high-dimensional robot motion planning while accounting for the stiff, vibration-induced uncertainty of heavySep robotic systems. We demonstrate the success of our framework on the construction of a post-and-lintel structure using one robot arm as a timber gripper, and a second robot as a nail-21 fastener. Fig. 1. Dual-arm gantry and manipulator setup which holds a timber gripper on one arm and a nail gun on the other.

- Integrates explicit collision constraints with learned cable dynamics to ensure safe, synchronized motion among robots, assembly objects, and workspace boundaries.
- Addresses the stiff, vibration-induced uncertainty inherent in heavy robotic systems, enabling precise coordination in complex, changing work environments.
- Demonstrates the framework's effectiveness by successfully constructing a post-and-lintel structure using a dual-arm gantry equipped with a timber gripper and a nail fastener.

CoRe-MARL: Cooperative Redistribution Under Unknown Dynamics Using Recurrent Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

Abstract
Emergency management assistance programs, such as relief distribution, are
essential for delivering necessary supplies to affected communities. However,
these programs operate in a decentralized network of local centers that face
uncertain local demand and supply dynamics, resulting in inconsistent avail-
ability of local services. Redistribution of supplies among these local centers[cs.LG] reduces these imbalances, but the centers often make decisions independently,
with limited information and disrupted transportation. This study develops
CoRe-MARL, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) frame-
work, by formulating a decentralized partially observable Markov decision pro-
cess (Dec-POMDP). We treat each center as an agent that learns a redistribu-
tion policy to improve the service in the worst-case region and reduce the service
gap across regions while protecting network-wide service. We incorporate a re-
current network that captures evolving supply and demand dynamics without
direct observation, while multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO)
enables centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE). We evaluate
the framework in a simulated environment with diverse trajectories, where ex-
act dynamics are not observed by actors and the MAPPO critic. We compare
the recurrent MAPPO with the recurrent independent PPO (IPPO) and a local-
only heuristic, and find that MAPPO reduces the service gap across local centers
and enhances service for the worst-served center while maintaining competitivearXiv:2609.18639v1

across diverse trajectory patterns, demonstrating its ability to adapt to evolv-
ing dynamics. The findings demonstrate the capability of cooperative learning
for decentralized redistribution and improving equitable service under uncertain

- The problem is formulated as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP), where each center acts as an agent learning a policy to minimize the service gap across regions and improve service for the worst-case region while maintaining overall network-wide service levels.
- The framework utilizes a recurrent neural network to capture evolving supply and demand dynamics without direct observation, combined with Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) to enable centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE).
- Experimental evaluations in a simulated environment with diverse trajectories demonstrate that recurrent MAPPO outperforms recurrent independent PPO (IPPO) and local-only heuristics by significantly reducing service disparities and enhancing service for the least-served centers.
- The results highlight the robustness of the proposed approach, showing consistent performance across various trajectory patterns and confirming the effectiveness of cooperative learning for achieving equitable service distribution under uncertain and evolving conditions.

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a tldr summary in at most 120 words.

The summary must be a single sentence capturing the paper's core contribution.

Paper content:
Social Behavior Among Autonomous AI: How Large Language Models Interact in Dynamic Networks

Abstract
Cooperation is a cornerstone of human societies, enabling collective progress in dynamic and uncertain environ-
ments. With the advent of AI systems acting autonomously, it becomes crucial to understand not only human-AI
cooperation but also AI-AI interactions in adaptive networks. In this work, we examine the interactions of AI
using Large Language Models—Mistral, Llama3, Gemma3, and Phi3—in a public goods game within dynamic
network structures. Our experiments were conducted under single-model and mixed-model conditions across
Watts-Strogatz (WS), Barabási-Albert (BA), and Erdős-Rényi (ER) networks. We analyzed the impact of model
architecture, network topology, and prompt design on cooperative behavior. Results show that Mistral and
Llama3 offer high cooperation rates, while Phi3 shows defective tendencies. Additionally, the random structure
of Erdős-Rényi networks dramatically improves cooperation. Prompt design also plays a key role; a society-
benefits prompt leads to a higher cooperation level. These findings offer a preliminary framework for LLM-based
simulations in adaptive social networks.

Keywords
AI & AI Interaction, Large Language Models, Public Goods Game, Dynamic Networks

Write only the summary.

This study investigates AI-AI cooperation by simulating Large Language Models in public goods games across dynamic network topologies, revealing that model architecture, network structure, and prompt design significantly influence cooperative behavior, with Mistral and Llama3 exhibiting high cooperation rates, Erdős-Rényi networks enhancing collaboration, and society-benefits prompts further boosting cooperative outcomes.

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a bullet summary in at most 60 words.

The summary must be 3-5 bullet points, each starting with '- '.

Paper content:
Rare Event Estimation via Iterative Unalignment

Abstract
As agents are deployed with increased autonomy, even extremely rare events along their
stochastic output trajectories can occur and prove catastrophic. Safe deployment therefore does
not depend on whether these events can occur, but on how often they might. We study the problem
of estimating the probability of rare events that arise from stochastic variation in the agent’s own
actions. Estimating this type of risk requires searching over the combinatorially vast space of
trajectories. Naive Monte Carlo is computationally prohibitive in this regime, and constructing2026
effective importance sampling (IS) proposals requires coordinated changes to a context-dependent
chain of conditional distributions. We develop a new IS method that perturbs the original
model’s weights to construct the proposal. The proposal is itself a differentiably parameterizedSep
language model, enabling gradient-based search over weight space. We formulate an objective
that combines a differentiable surrogate for event amplification and an adaptive regularization21
scheme that dynamically balances amplification against estimator stability. We evaluate our
approach on ∼120M and ∼2.6B models across three event families spanning 300+ rare events as
rare as 10−9, with reference probabilities computed with < 10% relative standard error. In our
most verifiable settings, we observe that our IS estimator achieves over 800× compute-weighted
efficiency gains over naive Monte Carlo for events with probabilities lower than 10−7. Our
implementation is available at https://github.com/namkoong-lab/iterative-unalignment.[cs.LG]

Write only the summary.

- Addresses the challenge of estimating probabilities for rare, catastrophic events in autonomous agent trajectories.
- Proposes an importance sampling method that perturbs model weights to create a differentiable proposal distribution.
- Utilizes gradient-based search with adaptive regularization to balance event amplification and estimator stability.
- Demonstrates over 800× efficiency gains over naive Monte Carlo for events with probabilities below 10⁻⁷.

## Problem & Approach
MIGU addresses multimodal instruction grounding for robots by fusing uncertain verbal cues and pointing gestures. It combines semantic priors from Vision-Language Models with a 3D geometric likelihood derived from eye-finger geometry, accounting for sensing and estimation errors.

## Methodology
The framework uses Bayes-inspired fusion to integrate these complementary signals into a unified belief over target objects. An attribute-based planner then decides whether to proceed with manipulation or request clarification from the user to resolve ambiguity.

## Results
Evaluated on real-world benchmarks, MIGU outperforms existing baselines in grounding accuracy. Ablation studies confirm that explicitly modeling multimodal uncertainty and separating semantic from geometric beliefs significantly enhances robustness in open-world manipulation tasks.

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a tldr summary in at most 250 words.

The summary must be a single sentence capturing the paper's core contribution.

Paper content:
Rare Event Estimation via Iterative Unalignment

Abstract
As agents are deployed with increased autonomy, even extremely rare events along their
stochastic output trajectories can occur and prove catastrophic. Safe deployment therefore does
not depend on whether these events can occur, but on how often they might. We study the problem
of estimating the probability of rare events that arise from stochastic variation in the agent’s own
actions. Estimating this type of risk requires searching over the combinatorially vast space of
trajectories. Naive Monte Carlo is computationally prohibitive in this regime, and constructing2026
effective importance sampling (IS) proposals requires coordinated changes to a context-dependent
chain of conditional distributions. We develop a new IS method that perturbs the original
model’s weights to construct the proposal. The proposal is itself a differentiably parameterizedSep
language model, enabling gradient-based search over weight space. We formulate an objective
that combines a differentiable surrogate for event amplification and an adaptive regularization21
scheme that dynamically balances amplification against estimator stability. We evaluate our
approach on ∼120M and ∼2.6B models across three event families spanning 300+ rare events as
rare as 10−9, with reference probabilities computed with < 10% relative standard error. In our
most verifiable settings, we observe that our IS estimator achieves over 800× compute-weighted
efficiency gains over naive Monte Carlo for events with probabilities lower than 10−7. Our
implementation is available at https://github.com/namkoong-lab/iterative-unalignment.[cs.LG]

Write only the summary.

This paper introduces Iterative Unalignment, a novel importance sampling method for estimating the probability of rare, catastrophic events in autonomous agent trajectories by differentially perturbing the original model's weights to construct an optimized proposal distribution, achieving over 800x compute-weighted efficiency gains compared to naive Monte Carlo for events with probabilities below 10^-7.

Paper content:
GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation

Abstract
We present a compact geometry-native latent space as a shared foundation for
perception and generation. Visual generators can produce photorealistic frames
without preserving a consistent 3D scene. We argue that this is not only a mod-arXiv:2609.24981v1
eling problem but also a representation problem: generators typically evolve
appearance-centric latents, while perception models recover geometry in a se-
mantically rich space that encodes cross-view structure. Rather than adding ge-
ometry as another output, we reparameterize a geometry foundation model’s fea-
tures into a compact latent space for generation. We realize this shift with the

PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control

Abstract
Diffusion models offer flexible motion generation, but translating this flexibil- ity into feedback-responsive humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical systems steer motion through references that may exceed a separate tracker’s ca- pabilities, leaving recovery and physical execution largely to the tracker. Action- only diffusion generates actions directly but lacks an explicit future-state trajec- tory for test-time motion objectives. Joint state–action diffusion provides this rep- resentation, yet representative controllers often depend on privileged full-body states, and support for learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remains fragmented. We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion pol- icy that brings these complementary steering capabilities into one directly exe- cuted policy using proprioceptive observations. Write only the summary.

- PredActor is a predictive action diffusion policy for steerable onboard humanoid control.
- It jointly generates executable actions and internal future-state trajectories from proprioceptive inputs.
- The approach integrates complementary steering capabilities into a single directly executed policy.
- Classifier-free guidance is utilized to enhance text-conditioned motion generation.

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

Paper content:
Feedback Coding Enables Inference-Time Covert Agentic Communication

Abstract
AbstractSep As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate digital interactions, users can leverage LLM-generated text as cover for covert communication within seemingly benign conversations.21 Existing LLM steganography, however, is predominantly white-box, requiring the sender and receiver to share the cover statistics, typically through access to the model weights and prompt. Black-box schemes remove this requirement by allowing the receiver to operate solely on the generated text, but current approaches rely on fixed-length, open-loop watermarking techniques that suffer from high decoding error rates under variable-length token generation. We recast black-box LLM steganography as a sequential[cs.IT] communication problem with causal, noiseless feedback: every generated token is observed by both parties and can guide subsequent embedding. Based on this perspective, we introduce Burnashev Adaptive Posterior Matching (BAM), a feedback-coding scheme that combines posterior matching with a decode-and-confirm phase. The design is inspired by classical information-theoretic feedback- coding principles, while its security is established through a cryptographic reduction proof. Across three open-weight language models, we demonstrate that BAM attains 0-0.1% empirical message error on an 8-bit payload in around 50 tokens, across 1000 trials, versus 10-17% for the strongest black-box baseline at comparable length. Building on the proposed steganography algorithm, we demonstrate the feasibility of an end-to-end communication protocol that achieves high communication rates across multiple conversational settings.

Write only the summary.

- The paper addresses the limitations of existing black-box LLM steganography, which relies on fixed-length, open-loop watermarking and suffers from high decoding error rates due to the variable nature of token generation. It proposes recasting this problem as a sequential communication task with causal, noiseless feedback, where every generated token is observed by both sender and receiver to guide subsequent embedding.
- The authors introduce Burnashev Adaptive Posterior Matching (BAM), a novel feedback-coding scheme that integrates posterior matching with a decode-and-confirm phase. This design leverages classical information-theoretic feedback-coding principles to improve reliability, while its security is rigorously established through a cryptographic reduction proof.
- Experimental results across three open-weight language models demonstrate that BAM significantly outperforms the strongest black-box baseline. Specifically, BAM achieves an empirical message error rate of 0–0.1% for an 8-bit payload embedded in approximately 50 tokens over 1,000 trials, compared to 10–17% error rates for the baseline at comparable lengths.
- Building on the proposed steganography algorithm, the study demonstrates the feasibility of an end-to-end covert communication protocol. This protocol achieves high communication rates across multiple conversational settings, enabling users to leverage LLM-generated text as cover for secure, covert agentic communication without requiring white-box access to model weights.

Write only the summary.

- **Problem Addressed**: High-resolution image restoration, particularly at 4K resolution, is computationally expensive and prone to artifacts like repeated or inconsistent textures when using direct diffusion-based methods.
- **Core Architecture**: MagnifiQ adapts pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models (e.g., SDXL) for scalable high-resolution inference by replacing standard self-attention layers with convolutional operations, ensuring computational cost grows linearly with image resolution.
- **Progressive Upscaling Strategy**: The framework employs a multi-stage progressive upscaling approach (e.g., from 1024×1024 to 4096×4096) that iteratively refines intermediate outputs. This method improves global structural coherence and reduces high-resolution artifacts compared to directly generating the final high-resolution image.
- **Patch-Aware Guidance**: To enhance local details while preventing content drift, MagnifiQ utilizes patch-specific text prompts. These provide spatially localized semantic guidance during the restoration process, ensuring fine-grained details are recovered accurately.
- **Performance Capabilities**: The system supports up to 32× scaling factors, successfully restoring real-world low-quality inputs into coherent, high-resolution outputs up to 4096×4096 pixels while preserving both global structure and fine details.

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
