Paper content:
Minimum Time Trajectories for a Car-Like Mobile Robot Moving with Rigid Wheels Under Non-Sliding Constraints

Abstract
Abstract This paper studies the minimum time trajectories of a car-like mobile robot navigating in2026 an obstacle free environment. The robot, with forward and backward speeds, is controlled by bounded front-wheels acceleration and limited front-wheels steering rate. The paper extends previous resultsSep which solved this problem for the kinematic car-like robot. However the kinematic model assumes 21 pure rolling at the wheels ground contacts. This assumption requires non-sliding constraints for the front and rear wheels that can only be handled by the robot dynamics. This paper formulates the non-sliding constraints based on the robot dynamics then augments the kinematic model time-optimal path primitives with three new path primitives associated with the non-sliding constraints. The three non-sliding path primitives together with the kinematic model twelve path primitives form the car-like robot time optimal trajectories. Approximate analytic solutions for the non-sliding path primitives[cs.RO] are also provided. Examples study the time-optimal path primitives along representative maneuvers, illustrating how the non-sliding constraints influence the time optimal trajectories of the car-like robot.

Write only the summary.

This paper extends the minimum time trajectory planning for car-like mobile robots by incorporating rigid wheel non-sliding constraints derived from robot dynamics, augmenting the standard kinematic model with three new path primitives to form complete time-optimal trajectories and providing approximate analytic solutions for these new primitives.

Generating Chest X-Ray Counterfactuals by Specialising Foundation Image Models

Abstract
AbstractSep 21 Counterfactuallooked under retrospective,image generationhypotheticalanswersscenarios.questions Recentabout howmethodsa subjecthavewouldimprovedhave perceptual quality, identity preservation and faithfulness to an underlying causal model, but their adoption in healthcare is limited by scarce annotated data, distribu- tion shift between datasets, and mismatches between pretrained generative models and those required for counterfactual inference. We propose specialisation, a data and parameter-efficient framework for adapting pretrained, non-causal generative models into causal mechanisms under distribution shift. Based on this framework,[cs.CV] we train a radiology counterfactual image generation model, called RadCF, using latent flow matching. We validate our approach on three chest X-ray datasets span- ning different dataset shifts, data volumes, and counterfactual questions, associated with challenging, highly-localised interventions. Our results show that RadCF and specialisation improve counterfactual soundness over existing methods while being data and parameter efficient, and that the resulting counterfactuals can detect and mitigate shortcut learning in a downstream medical classifier.     force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

Paper content:
Harness-Zero: Harness Distillation via Agent-as-Harness

Abstract
2026 Agent harnesses, the external systems that mediate model-environment interaction, can substantially improve agent performance, but their gains remain tied to the harness at deployment. Because the best harness varies across domains, instances, and models, a general-purpose agent must either settle for a suboptimal sharedSep harness or route among an ever-growing set of specialized ones. We therefore study agent harness distillation: 21 usinginto modela domain-weights,or instance-optimizedso that its gains surviveharnessunderas training-timea single fixedguidancetargetandharness.transferringThe challengethe behaviorsis thatit theinducestwo harnesses differ in action space and available information, so guidance from the optimized harness cannot serve directly as supervision for the target one. We introduce HARNESS-ZERO, which enables harness distillation through agent-as-harness. Guided by the optimized harness, a harnessing agent corrects student responses before execution in the target harness’s action space, turning harness guidance into training demonstrations. Fine-tuning on the resulting trajectories internalizes harness-induced behavior into the model, so the specialized[cs.AI] harness can be removed at deployment. Our experiments spanning knowledge work, tool use, and science domains show that: ❶For frontier LLMs using the same evolved harness, agent-as-harness outperforms code-as- harness. ❷With the specialized harness removed at deployment, HARNESS-ZERO improves the base model’s macro-average task success from 23.3% to 44.3%, even exceeding the 41.7% it reaches with that harness still attached. ❸HARNESS-ZERO recovers harness-induced behaviors absent from the base model, with 82.3% average recovery across 28 patterns in the three domains.

Write only the summary.

HARNESS-ZERO introduces agent-as-harness distillation to internalize specialized harness behaviors into model weights, enabling deployment without the external harness and significantly improving task success rates across diverse domains.

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10

    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a bullet summary in at most 250 words.

The summary must be 3-5 bullet points, each starting with '- '.

Paper content:
Learning Prognostic Variables for AI Convective Parameterizations via Symbolic Distillation

Abstract
Hybrid AI-physics climate modeling aims to improve coarse (∼100km-resolution) Earth
system models by learning to parameterize subgrid processes from high-fidelity data. How-
ever, this so far mostly involves local-in-time, diagnostic parameterizations, in which the
subgrid state depends only on the current coarse state with no memory of previous states,
which is unrealistic for processes such as convection that have intrinsic persistence. To
address this, we enhance local-in-time parameterizations by learning prognostic variables
that compactly carry important, additional past information where no explicit sub-grid
information is available. First we compress past information into a low-dimensional la-
tent space using an autoencoder, which then informs a neural network trained to param-
eterize targeted subgrid-scale processes. We then replace the autoencoder with symbolic
equations that govern the time evolution of the latent variables, yielding additional prog-
nostic memory variables that can be integrated alongside the resolved atmospheric state.
We evaluate this approach on two systems: the Lorenz-96 model (online) and surface pre-
cipitation from high-resolution atmospheric simulations (offline). A forced multivariate
linear ordinary differential equation recovers most of the added value achieved by the
autoencoder-based approach in both experiments. Benchmarked against diagnostic pa-
rameterizations without memory, our memory-informed approach improves climate statis-
tics and temporal structure, including a realistic diurnal cycle of tropical land precip-
itation.

Plain Language Summary

Earth system models (ESMs) evolve the Earth’s climate through a set of govern-
ing equations on a coarse resolution grid to maintain computational feasibility. Phys-
ical processes below the computed resolution need to be approximated with parameter-
izations. Atmospheric patterns, like organized moisture patches, leave a fingerprint on
the time series of grid-scale state variables inducing a memory of the past. We improve
parameterizations by leveraging this information with a Machine Learning (ML) model
creating a new set of variables that expand the governing equations of the dynamical core.
The ML model can be replaced by approximating its behavior with a set of evolution
equations that can be interpreted and simulated efficiently unlike the original ML model.
We test our approach with an atmospheric toy model and a realistic parameterization
of precipitation. We find that the new equations recover most of the predictive skill added
by ML unlike parameterizations without memory.

Write only the summary.

- The paper addresses the limitation of local-in-time, diagnostic AI parameterizations in coarse-resolution Earth system models, which lack the memory necessary to realistically simulate persistent subgrid processes like convection.
- The authors propose a method to learn prognostic variables that compactly encode past information, enhancing the model's ability to capture intrinsic persistence and improve the accuracy of subgrid-scale process approximations.
- The approach involves compressing historical data into a low-dimensional latent space using an autoencoder, which informs a neural network for parameterization, and subsequently replacing the autoencoder with symbolic equations to govern the evolution of these latent variables.
- By deriving symbolic ordinary differential equations from the learned latent dynamics, the method yields interpretable and computationally efficient prognostic memory variables that can be integrated alongside the resolved atmospheric state.
- Evaluations on the Lorenz-96 model and high-resolution atmospheric precipitation simulations demonstrate that a forced multivariate linear ODE recovers most of the predictive skill of the autoencoder-based approach, significantly improving climate statistics and temporal structures, such as the diurnal cycle of tropical land precipitation.

  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1

Paper content:
SocioVerse2: A Longitudinal Dynamic Social Simulation Framework under a Human-AI Co-evolutionary Paradigm

Abstract
Social simulation offers the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot
supply, and generative agents have transformed it by acting as silicon samples that unite agent-based[cs.CL] modeling with real behavioral data. Existing platforms verify collective behavior, align simulated
populations with real societies in cross-sections, and employ autonomous agents for the research
process. However, two social science requirements remain without systematic support: intervention
in the content of a simulation and the researcher’s control over the process that produces it. We
present SOCIOVERSE2, which extends SOCIOVERSE 1.0 into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm
built from two loops and one infrastructure. The longitudinal simulation loop simulates the target
population with evolving environments and forks counterfactual branches via interventions. The
controllable research loop takes the study itself as an editable state and updates state versions via
controllable editing. The social science agentic infrastructure carries both loops through composable
skills with researcher checkpoints, a population service over five persona pools, and an environment
service over 21 real-world signal sources with point-in-time guarantees. We validate SOCIOVERSE2
across three case families and seven case studies, from reproducing canonical agent-based models
to modeling policy processes on real records and nowcasting macro-economic indices beyond the
response model’s knowledge cutoff. With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases
go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions
in their respective disciplines. Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-sourcearXiv:2609.24911v1 resources.

*Equal contribution.
†Corresponding authors.
This work was completed during the research period at Shanghai Innovation Institute.

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a bullet summary in at most 250 words.

The summary must be 3-5 bullet points, each starting with '- '.

Paper content:
GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay

Abstract
Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different horizons for diverse model families. GameHorizon Suite consists of three components. First, GameHorizon-Annotator is a scalable and automated annotation pipeline for multi-horizon2026 instructions. Second, utilizing the pipeline, we construct GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset with temporally aligned videos, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions. It comprises 5,000 hours of recordings from 21 games, collected by 100 human expert players. Third,Sep we build GameHorizon-Bench with reproducible offline and stepwise online testing. The offline track enables reproducible evaluation using thousands of standardized questions organized into three primary21 tasks and a series of diagnostic variants, while the online track tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay capabilities and localizes failures to specific steps within long-horizon gameplay. Based on our GameHorizon Suite, we evaluate 47 models through more than one million model invocations, revealing a meaningful hierarchy of task difficulty and pronounced differences in model capabilities. Our work can provide a standardized yardstick for evaluating gameplay capabilities across horizons and model families. We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research.[cs.CV] Project Page: https://gamehorizon-suite.github.io Github: https://github.com/TencentARC/GameHorizon

Write only the summary.

- Introduces GameHorizon Suite, a unified framework for evaluating AI gameplay capabilities across diverse model families and temporal horizons, addressing limitations in existing benchmarks such as narrow game coverage, lack of language instructions, and high-variance online rollouts.
- Presents GameHorizon-Annotator, a scalable automated pipeline for generating multi-horizon instructions, and GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset featuring 5,000 hours of recordings from 21 games with temporally aligned videos, player actions, and expert-collected data.
- Develops GameHorizon-Bench, a dual-track evaluation system comprising an offline track with thousands of standardized questions for reproducible testing and an online track that validates offline scores against actual gameplay while localizing failures to specific steps in long-horizon tasks.
- Evaluates 47 models through over one million invocations, revealing a clear hierarchy of task difficulty and significant performance differences across model families, thereby establishing a standardized yardstick for assessing visual understanding, planning, and action control in gaming contexts.
- Commits to releasing the dataset, annotator, and benchmark to the research community, facilitating future studies on multi-horizon gameplay and providing a comprehensive testbed for advancing AI models in complex, interactive environments.

## Problem Context
Range-Aided Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (RA-SLAM) initialization is critical for underwater navigation using Long Baseline (LBL) transponders. Existing methods, such as spectral graph partitioning and nonlinear least-squares approaches, often fail to account for sensor noise or exploit highly accurate heading information. Furthermore, current solutions like LAGO and Synthetic LBL lack robustness in sparse connectivity scenarios or rely heavily on specific trajectory shapes, limiting their general applicability for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs).

## Proposed Method
This paper introduces a novel RA-SLAM initialization technique that leverages the separable structure of the SLAM problem when accurate heading data is available. The method estimates LBL transponder and AUV positions in the world frame using linear least-squares, providing a robust initialization for subsequent nonlinear RA-SLAM. A key innovation is the conversion of LBL range measurements into relative positions between the transponder and the AUV-mounted transceiver, resolved in the AUV body frame via a Generalized Trust Region Subproblem (GTRS). This approach also characterizes the uncertainty associated with these relative position estimates, enhancing the reliability of the initialization process.

## Experimental Validation
The proposed approach was experimentally validated against the SCORE method using a real-world AUV dataset. The dataset included highly accurate Inertial Navigation System (INS) heading, Doppler Velocity Log (DVL)-derived velocity, LBL range measurements, and groundtruth data. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the method in real-world conditions, addressing the limitations of previous approaches that struggle with unconstrained trajectories or insufficient range measurements.

## Availability
An open-source implementation of the proposed RA-SLAM initialization method is available on GitHub, facilitating further research and application in underwater navigation systems.

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10

  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a tldr summary in at most 120 words.

The summary must be a single sentence capturing the paper's core contribution.

Paper content:
PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control

Abstract
Diffusion models offer flexible motion generation, but translating this flexibil- ity into feedback-responsive humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical systems steer motion through references that may exceed a separate tracker’s ca- pabilities, leaving recovery and physical execution largely to the tracker. Action- only diffusion generates actions directly but lacks an explicit future-state trajec- tory for test-time motion objectives. Joint state–action diffusion provides this rep- resentation, yet representative controllers often depend on privileged full-body states, and support for learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remains fragmented. We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion pol- icy that brings these complementary steering capabilities into one directly exe- cuted policy using proprioceptive observations. Conditioned on proprioceptive history and optional task context, PredActor jointly generates executable actions and an internal future-state trajectory. Classifier-free guidance strengthens text-

Write only the summary.

PredActor is a predictive action diffusion policy that unifies executable action generation and internal future-state trajectory prediction within a single directly executed controller, enabling steerable onboard humanoid control using only proprioceptive observations and optional task context.

    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

CPI-Bench: A Comprehensive,Practical and Intelligent Benchmark for Real-World Image Editing

Abstract
With the rapid advancement of image editing models and their widespread application
across various domains, there is an increasingly urgent need to deploy these model
capabilities directly into real-world scenarios. However, existing benchmarks remain
confined to simple single-image tasks, suffering from limited coverage dimensions
and an inability to effectively differentiate performance among diverse models. Con-
sequently, they fail to reliably evaluate model performance in complex multi-image2026
editing, highly demanding reasoning instructions, and practical deployment settings.
To address these limitations, we propose CPI-Bench, a Comprehensive, Practical and
Intelligent benchmark for real-world image editing. CPI-Bench comprises three coreAug subsets: CPI-General-Bench, which comprehensively covers diverse editing tasks and
pioneers the inclusion of multi-image editing evaluation; CPI-Practical-Bench, which
14 focuses on high-frequency real-user application scenarios; and CPI-Intelligent-Bench,
which is dedicated to evaluating capabilities in highly demanding reasoning-based
editing. Evaluation results of mainstream image editing models based on CPI-Bench
demonstrate that CPI-Bench enhances performance differentiation among models. It
provides a comprehensive and reliable quantification of gaps in general editing capa-
bilities, practical deployment efficacy, and advanced reasoning-based editing, offering
invaluable guidance for the future optimization of image editing models. Crucially,[cs.CV] our ranking analysis reveals that CPI-Bench achieves the highest alignment with the
Arena Image Edit Leaderboard, indicating it faithfully captures the preferences and
perceptual judgments of human evaluators, serving as a robust proxy for real-world user
experience.

benchmarks, achieving the highest correlation and the lowest error margin.

Paper content:
RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses

Abstract
An LLM agent’s capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level.     paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

  参数:

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10

    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.

    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

Learning Beyond What Humans Can Demonstrate

Abstract
Behavior cloning for robot manipulation relies on expert demonstra- tions. However, for tasks that require dynamic stability, precise contact timing, or dexterous coordination, human operators may find it hard or even impossible to collect data. We study this infeasible-demonstration regime and propose GLIDE: Guardrails for Learning from Infeasible Demonstrations Efficiently, a framework that infers task-specific failure modes and converts them into executable guardrails2026 for data collection and policy deployment. Given a task description and the con- ditioning teleoperation code, GLIDE writes guardrails that use system states to filter teleoperation and policy commands, constrain failure-prone actions, and it-Sep eratively improve from trajectory feedback. Across three tasks, GLIDE discov- 21 ersing emergentdata collectionguardrailsoverthatnaivego VRbeyondteleoperationdomain-expertand domain-experthardcoded ones,hardcodedimprov- guardrails. After refinement, GLIDE raises data-collection success from 0–10% to 70–90% across the three tasks. During policy execution, mixed-data guarded policies reach 70%, 60%, and 60% success on Tomato plate transfer, Marker han- dover & stand, and Wine serving tasks. These results show that GLIDE can sup- port policy learning when direct demonstrations are infeasible. Project website:[cs.RO] http://guardrail-policy.github.io/.

GLIDE is a framework that addresses the infeasible-demonstration regime in robot manipulation by inferring task-specific failure modes and converting them into executable guardrails that filter teleoperation and policy commands, thereby improving data collection success from 0–10% to 70–90% and enabling effective policy learning for tasks where human experts cannot directly provide demonstrations.

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1

    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

- The study investigates whether Louvain community prototypes enhance open-set malware family recognition by adding rejection information beyond graph neural network (GIN) embeddings and dimension-matched generic topology controls.
- Using a leakage-audited FCG-MFD corpus with five held-out families, the research residualizes community features against generic topology to isolate mesoscopic structural contributions from confounding factors like graph scale and density.
- Results indicate that residual community prototypes fail to produce stable rejection of unknown families, with false-positive rates at 95% recall worsening for every held-out family and a validation-fitted threshold rejecting only 4.48% of unknown samples.
- While known-family macro F1 scores show marginal improvement, the effect is statistically insignificant (p=0.0625), and performance metrics such as AUROC and AUPRC do not significantly outperform the generic-topology control or simple classifier uncertainty baselines.
- The findings suggest that in this GIN/FCG-MFD setting, community-enriched prototypes alter known-class geometry without creating a reliable unknown margin, highlighting the need for matched topology controls and family-specific analysis in open-set evaluations.

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值

    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10

  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

Thought: 任务已完成
Action: FINISH
如果任务因为缺少必要上下文、参数非法或工具能力不支持而无法执行，不要编造
参数或调用注定失败的工具；请在 Thought 中明确说明无法执行的原因，再用
Action: FINISH 结束。此时不要声称任务已经完成。
注意：只能使用上面列出的工具。每次只能执行一个动作。
强约束：
- Action 后必须是“严格 JSON”(双引号、true/false/null, 小写)
- 禁止 Python 风格 True/False/None
- 禁止尾随逗号、注释、以及任何额外文本
关于“指代上一条操作的论文”：
- 当用户没有给出明确的论文序号/ID/标题，但你判断用户是在指代“最近一次操作过的那篇论文”（例如上下文中的指代性表达），
  则在调用需要论文引用的工具时，把 args 里的 ref 设置为 null(JSON null), 由工具自动定位最近操作的论文。
- 如果用户给出了明确序号/ID/标题，则正常传 ref。
关于异步任务（翻译）：
- translate_arxiv_pdf 是异步任务，调用后会立即返回 task_id 和 PENDING 状态。
- 翻译进度由前端通过 SSE 实时推送，你不需要也不应该轮询检查翻译状态。
- 调用 translate_arxiv_pdf 之后，直接 FINISH 即可，不要再调用 get_paper_cache_status 去查看翻译是否完成。
正确示例：
Action: {"name":"translate_arxiv_pdf","args":{"ref":2,"session_id":"demo1","force":false,"service":"bing","threads":4,"keep_dual":false}}

Out-of-Distribution Generalisation with Sequence Models in Offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

Abstract
Generalising to unseen tasks remains a fundamental challenge in offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). In this work, we present a principled analysisSep of zero-shot task generalisation in the offline setting and conduct an extensive 3 empirical investigation into the scaling behaviour governing task diversity, dataset size, and network capacity. To facilitate this study, we extend offline sequence modelling architectures to handle multi-task observation and action spaces along- side variable agent counts across tasks. Our primary finding is that scaling task diversity—rather than sheer dataset size—is the dominant factor in achieving ro- bust zero-shot transfer. These results suggest that the development of generalisable MARL agents should prioritise the diversity of the training distribution with varying numbers of agents, providing a roadmap for scaling offline MARL effectively.

  参数:

## Method Overview
This paper introduces SE(3) Neural Potential Fields for 6-DoF trajectory planning directly from images, eliminating the need for explicit 3D reconstruction. The model learns a potential field $\phi_{\theta,3D}$ that couples position and orientation, using a three-point gripper mapping to ensure the field is invariant to unobservable per-view offsets. By distilling distance information from a learned repulsive head and anchoring the field to a target grasp pose detected by AnyGrasp, the approach creates a robust potential well centered at the goal configuration.

## Loss Function Design
The training objective combines multiple terms to ensure physical consistency and navigability. Key components include a Goal Potential Loss that pins the potential to zero at the target, and a Gradient Magnitude Loss that enforces non-vanishing slopes near the goal to prevent stalls. A Gradient Alignment Loss ensures the negative gradient points toward the target in the coupled position-rotation vector space. Additionally, an Orientation Bowl Loss regularizes the field to grow with distance from the target, providing usable descent directions for large initial orientation errors.

## Navigation and Planning
To address the classical weakness of artificial potential fields—spurious minima where attractive and repulsive gradients cancel—the method employs navigation-function supervision. This includes direction, descent progress, and scale terms that forbid flat regions and ensure the field gradient aligns with the true distance gradient. At runtime, trajectory planning is executed via damped gradient descent on the learned potential field. Position and quaternion gradients are obtained through automatic differentiation, smoothed with exponential moving average and momentum, and applied with adaptive step sizes that shrink near the target to ensure precise convergence.

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a tldr summary in at most 120 words.

The summary must be a single sentence capturing the paper's core contribution.

Paper content:
VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents

Abstract
Recent advances in video generative models have enabled high-fidelity, temporally coherent
video generation. However, these models often struggle to satisfy prompts requiring
specialized knowledge, specific identities, physical consistency, or ordered events. In this
paper, we present VideoGen-Agent, a multimodal agent trained through multitask agentic
reinforcement learning to use external tools for video generation. The agent coordinates
augmentation, generation, and verification tools through multi-turn interactions, using the
prompt and intermediate observations to guide its decisions. We train a shared policy on a
category-balanced dataset spanning six tasks. Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated
trajectories establishes tool-use behavior, which is then refined through reinforcement
learning. A category-aware hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity, task-appropriate tool
use, and generated video quality. We further introduce VABench, a held-out benchmark of
600 prompts covering procedural knowledge, single- and multi-entity identity preservation,arXiv:2609.24997v1 physical consistency, scene composition, and multi-shot temporal structure. On VABench,
VideoGen-Agent improves over its base text-to-video generator by 19.1 points, from
56.5 to 75.6. Upgrading the generation tools further raises the score to 86.1 without
additional agent training. Human raters prefer the upgraded configuration over the
strongest standalone baseline in 84.3% of comparisons. These results support learning
tool use across video-generation tasks and show that the trained agent can benefit from
subsequent advances in generation tools.

Project homepage: andyca111.github.io/VideoGen_Agent
VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents

Write only the summary.

VideoGen-Agent is a multimodal agent trained via multitask agentic reinforcement learning to coordinate external tools for video generation, achieving a 19.1-point improvement over base models on the new VABench benchmark by effectively managing tool-use behaviors for complex prompts requiring specialized knowledge, identity preservation, and physical consistency.

    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default

    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1
