    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default

    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

CAST: Collision-Aware Assembly with Construction Robots using Simultaneous Trajectory Estimation and Planning

Abstract
Multi-robot systems have shown increasing via- bility in construction due to their ability to execute high- precision actions while reducing human exposure to hazardous tasks. The summary must have 3-4 short sections, each starting with a '## ' header.

Paper content:
PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control

Abstract
Diffusion models offer flexible motion generation, but translating this flexibil- ity into feedback-responsive humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical systems steer motion through references that may exceed a separate tracker’s ca- pabilities, leaving recovery and physical execution largely to the tracker. Action- only diffusion generates actions directly but lacks an explicit future-state trajec- tory for test-time motion objectives. Joint state–action diffusion provides this rep- resentation, yet representative controllers often depend on privileged full-body states, and support for learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remains fragmented. We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion pol- icy that brings these complementary steering capabilities into one directly exe- cuted policy using proprioceptive observations. Conditioned on proprioceptive history and optional task context, PredActor jointly generates executable actions and an internal future-state trajectory. Classifier-free guidance strengthens text-

Write only the summary.

## Problem
Translating diffusion model flexibility into responsive humanoid control is difficult. Hierarchical systems often fail when references exceed tracker capabilities, while action-only diffusion lacks explicit future-state trajectories for test-time steering.

## Method
PredActor is a predictive action diffusion policy that uses only proprioceptive observations. It jointly generates executable actions and an internal future-state trajectory, conditioned on history and optional task context.

## Key Features
The model employs classifier-free guidance to enhance text-based steering. It integrates behavior selection and motion steering into a single, directly executed policy, eliminating the need for privileged full-body states or separate trackers.

## Impact
PredActor unifies complementary steering capabilities, enabling robust, feedback-responsive humanoid control with improved recovery and physical execution without relying on fragmented hierarchical architectures.

Paper content:
From Learning to Control: Data-Driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Multivariable Control in a Microalgae Bioprocess

Abstract
Effective control of bioprocesses is particularly challenging due to the intrinsic nonlinearity and dy-
namic variability of living-cell systems. In microalgae-based photobioreactors (PBRs), maintaining
stable pH and dissolved oxygen (DO) levels is critical for optimal growth and productivity, yet their
strong coupling and sensitivity to environmental ﬂuctuations make multivariable control difﬁcult.
This study proposes a novel hybrid ofﬂine-online Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL)
framework for simultaneous pH and DO regulation, leveraging Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient
(DDPG) agents to achieve a fully data-driven and model-free control solution. The agents are trained
using historical data generated by an expert system, eliminating the need for direct experimentation
with the environment. After deployment, the agents operate autonomously, continuously ﬁne-tuning
their policies daily to adapt to evolving process dynamics and reject fast transient disturbances. Ex-
perimental validation in an open, industrial-scale PBR at the University of Almería demonstrated the
frameworks capability to maintain stable operation under realistic conditions. The results conﬁrm
that model-free MARL control provides a robust and adaptive alternative for complex bioprocess
environments.arXiv:2609.09313v1

Keywords Ofﬂine reinforcement learning · Model-free control · Data-driven control · Artiﬁcial intelligence-based
control systems · Microalgae-based bioprocess.

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a bullet summary in at most 60 words.

The summary must be 3-5 bullet points, each starting with '- '.

Paper content:
Handover of In-Context Learning State Across Session Boundaries

Abstract
AbstractAug This study investigates the methodological and theoretical properties of session 14 handover in applications that use large language models. A task may continue in a new session when the context reaches the model’s input limit, when the application restarts, or when another agent is asked to finish the task. The application must then decide which information from the earlier session to pass on. We formulate handover as the transfer of a task-relative in-context learning (ICL) state and distinguish exact recovery[cs.AI] of earlier material from preservation of the target distribution. Under an exogeneity condition, predictive equivalence characterizes the coarsest deterministic sufficient handover and gives a fixed-length bit requirement. The analysis isolates the effects of the memory constraint, the writer, and the continuation procedure, and quantifies the cost of writing before the realized downstream query is known. We propose a three-part record that stores decisions and constraints exactly, uses task-justified statistics for repeated evidence, and retains original observations whose effect is not preserved by those statistics. Gaussian linear regression gives an exact finite-dimensional handover and finite-bit perturbation bounds, while nonparametric regression gives upper and lower bounds that relate memory to squared prediction error. These results provide a theory and method for deciding what a handover must retain and how its memory requirement depends on the continuation task.arXiv:2608.14528v1 Keywords: session handover; in-context learning; predictive sufficiency; memory-constrained prediction; prompt compression

Write only the summary.

- Formulates session handover as transferring in-context learning state, distinguishing exact recovery from preserving target distributions.
- Defines predictive equivalence to characterize the coarsest sufficient handover and determine fixed-length bit requirements.
- Proposes a three-part record storing exact decisions, task-justified statistics, and original observations.
- Derives exact handover bounds for Gaussian regression and relates memory to prediction error in nonparametric settings.

Abstract
Autonomous navigation on Mars requires vehi- cles to distinguish between traversable terrains across diverse and visually challenging environments. - The paper introduces a novel dataset derived from the Mars 2020 Perseverance rover, comprising 500 sols and 45km of trajectories to address the critical lack of large-scale data for off-world autonomous navigation. This dataset includes grayscale stereo image pairs, vehicle poses, accelerometer readings, rocker-bogie angles, and estimates of tilt and wheel slip, capturing diverse terrains such as sandy dunes, rocky patches, and flat bedrocks.
- An uncertainty-aware traversability estimation framework is proposed, which learns terrain representations from multimodal driving experience. This approach is designed to distinguish between traversable and non-traversable terrains in visually challenging environments, specifically targeting the unique mobility constraints of planetary vehicles where recovery from failure is impossible.
- Experimental results on the Mars 2020 dataset demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing baselines, achieving an AUROC of 0.874 and an F1 score of 0.758. These metrics represent improvements of 0.058 and 0.156, respectively, over the strongest baseline, while also securing the highest average precision and recall among compared approaches.
- The study validates the practical applicability of the model by integrating the learned visual representations into path planners, such as ENav, on a physical rover test bed. Notably, the model was trained entirely on Martian driving data and deployed directly without any finetuning on Earth-based images, highlighting its robustness and transferability for real-world off-world navigation tasks.

  参数:

    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4

    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

if capable techniques existed for personalizing an on-device LLM to a user’s medium-to-long-term
usage patterns, this would alleviate the scale-related challenges of mobile LLMs mentioned above.

On-device LLM personalization is an instance of ‘downstream’ LLM customization, whereby a LLM
is adapted to a novel task or user without adjusting the LLM’s parameters. There are two predominant
approaches. The first is parameter-efficient fine-tuning (‘PEFT’), which augments the LLM with
additional parameters and trains them such that the augmented LLM performs well for the given task
or user. An example in widespread use is low-rank adaptation (‘LoRA’) (Hu et al., 2021). The second
common approach to LLM customization is in-context learning (‘ICL’) (Brown et al., 2020), where
the LLM is provided with examples from the given task or user in its input sequence.

PEFT and ICL each have drawbacks, particularly when applied to on-device LLM personalization.
PEFT requires gradient descent to personalize a LoRA, a computationally prohibitive exercise on a
mobile device. ICL increases input sequence length and thus inference latency, which is typically
undesirable for interactive generative AI features. ICL also suffers worse quality as context length
grows4 (Liu et al., 2023; Li et al., 2024a). Considering that an LLM’s input sequence will also serve
other uses (e.g., as a conversation record during multi-turn chatbot interaction), it may be preferable to
utilize alternative manners of personalizing the on-device LLM to its user’s long-term characteristics.

In this work we present just such an alternative form of personalization, via LoRA-generating
hypernetworks. Entirely on device, the hypernetwork takes representative examples of a user as input
and produces a personalized LoRA as output, which is then attached to the on-device LLM. Li

- Introduces LoRA-generating hypernetworks to personalize on-device LLMs by mapping user context tokens to low-rank adaptations (LoRA) entirely on the device.
- Combines the computational feasibility of in-context learning (ICL) with the latency and quality benefits of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), avoiding the high compute costs of on-device gradient descent.
- Minimizes additional storage requirements by leveraging the target LLM’s existing weights within the hypernetwork architecture, making it highly suitable for resource-constrained mobile environments.
- Demonstrates superior performance on challenging long-form text generation tasks compared to ICL and PEFT baselines, offering a practical solution for improving mobile LLM quality without increasing inference latency.

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

强约束：
- Action 后必须是“严格 JSON”(双引号、true/false/null, 小写)

关于“指代上一条操作的论文”：
- 当用户没有给出明确的论文序号/ID/标题，但你判断用户是在指代“最近一次操作过的那篇论文”（例如上下文中的指代性表达），

- 如果用户给出了明确序号/ID/标题，则正常传 ref。
关于异步任务（翻译）：
- translate_arxiv_pdf 是异步任务，调用后会立即返回 task_id 和 PENDING 状态。
- 翻译进度由前端通过 SSE 实时推送，你不需要也不应该轮询检查翻译状态。
- 调用 translate_arxiv_pdf 之后，直接 FINISH 即可，不要再调用 get_paper_cache_status 去查看翻译是否完成。

    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing

    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a tldr summary in at most 120 words.

The summary must be a single sentence capturing the paper's core contribution.

Paper content:
Marionette: Predicting World States, Rendering Geometry, Painting Appearance

Abstract
Interactive game world models typically autoregress visual observations directly in pixel or latent space, forcing structured properties such as pose, geometry, and occlusion to be implicitly maintained by the same generative sequence. Over long horizons, errors in these latent world properties accumulate, making consistency and controllability fragile. We explicitly model the evolving world state, delegate exact geometric computation to a fixed, zero-parameter renderer, and leave the neural model to synthesize appearance. We instantiate this idea as Marionette, a world model for interactive games with articulated characters, consisting of three components. First, a two-stage autoregressive dynamics model predicts an explicit and interpretable 276-dimensional 3D world state comprising multi-entity articulated skeletons, metric root trajectories, and rotations. Second, a zero-parameter graphics bridge converts the predicted state into pose-control videos, computing world-space geometry and occlusion in closed form. Third, a control-conditioned video-diffusion2026 observation model synthesizes photorealistic RGB observations from the resulting structured controls. Our experiments establish two properties of Marionette. First, the predicted world state is directly controllable. Forcing a mismatched action stream changes root-aligned joint error by 31% acrossAug 48 held-out segments, so the articulated dynamics respond to the actions they are given. Second, long-horizon behaviour is determined in the state, and can be repaired there. Left free, the two 14 generated characters drift to 21.2 m apart (recorded sessions stay near 5 m) and a third of frames show ground penetration. Two rules imposed on the explicit state, a terrain collider and a separation cap, cut penetration by 66% and keep the pair engaged, with no change to the observation model. Routing appearance through the predicted state costs no fidelity we can detect, at an FVD of 831 against 799 for recorded pose. Together, these results show that Marionette provides an explicit and controllable world representation while preserving high-quality visual generation.[cs.CV] Date: August 17, 2026 Project Page: https://alayalab.github.io/Marionette/

Write only the summary.

Marionette introduces a world model for interactive games that explicitly predicts a 276-dimensional 3D state, delegates geometry to a zero-parameter renderer, and uses video diffusion for appearance, thereby enhancing long-horizon consistency and controllability while maintaining high visual fidelity.

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

- 当用户没有给出明确的论文序号/ID/标题，但你判断用户是在指代“最近一次操作过的那篇论文”（例如上下文中的指代性表达），

- translate_arxiv_pdf 是异步任务，调用后会立即返回 task_id 和 PENDING 状态。
- 翻译进度由前端通过 SSE 实时推送，你不需要也不应该轮询检查翻译状态。

    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

CPI-Bench: A Comprehensive,Practical and Intelligent Benchmark for Real-World Image Editing

Abstract
With the rapid advancement of image editing models and their widespread application
across various domains, there is an increasingly urgent need to deploy these model
capabilities directly into real-world scenarios. However, existing benchmarks remain
confined to simple single-image tasks, suffering from limited coverage dimensions
and an inability to effectively differentiate performance among diverse models. Con-
sequently, they fail to reliably evaluate model performance in complex multi-image2026
editing, highly demanding reasoning instructions, and practical deployment settings.
To address these limitations, we propose CPI-Bench, a Comprehensive, Practical and
Intelligent benchmark for real-world image editing. CPI-Bench comprises three coreAug subsets: CPI-General-Bench, which comprehensively covers diverse editing tasks and
pioneers the inclusion of multi-image editing evaluation; CPI-Practical-Bench, which
14 focuses on high-frequency real-user application scenarios; and CPI-Intelligent-Bench,
which is dedicated to evaluating capabilities in highly demanding reasoning-based
editing. Evaluation results of mainstream image editing models based on CPI-Bench
demonstrate that CPI-Bench enhances performance differentiation among models. It
provides a comprehensive and reliable quantification of gaps in general editing capa-
bilities, practical deployment efficacy, and advanced reasoning-based editing, offering
invaluable guidance for the future optimization of image editing models. Crucially,[cs.CV] our ranking analysis reveals that CPI-Bench achieves the highest alignment with the
Arena Image Edit Leaderboard, indicating it faithfully captures the preferences and
perceptual judgments of human evaluators, serving as a robust proxy for real-world user
experience.

  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

Learning to Drive on Mars: Visual Multimodal Traversability Estimation for Off-World Navigation

Abstract
Autonomous navigation on Mars requires vehi- cles to distinguish between traversable terrains across diverse and visually challenging environments. However, progress in learning-based navigation for off-world environments has been limited by the lack of large-scale datasets. Since landing in Jezero Crater, the Mars 2020 Perseverance rover has traversed terrain ranging from sandy dunes, rocky patches, and flat bedrocks. As a result, this paper presents a dataset spanning 500 sols and 45km of trajectories driven by both human operators2026 and the onboard planner, ENav. Our dataset contains grayscale stereo image pairs, poses, accelerometer readings, rocker-bogie angles, and estimates of tilt and wheel slip. Building on this dataset, we introduce an uncertainty-aware traversability-Sep estimation framework that learns terrain representations from multimodal driving experience. Finally, we show that the visual representations can be integrated into path planners, such as wheel slip, unexpected vehicle motion, or unfavorable inter- ENav, on a physical rover test bed.     force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

  参数:

    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing

    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default

Paper content:
PixelDiT2: Representation-Grounded Pixel Diffusion Transformers

Abstract
Recent advances in pixel-space diffusion models have narrowed the image quality gap with latent-space diffusion, but still converge more slowly and lag behind in final image quality. We argue that a key reason is the lack of an explicit representation prior: unlike latent diffusion, which usually denoises in a compact and structured latent space, pixel diffusion needs to learn denoising-friendly representations and pixel generation simultaneously from raw RGB space. To address this problem, we propose PixelDiT2, an end-to-end pixel-space diffusion model designed to2026 decouple representation learning from pixel generation without introducing an autoencoder or latent reconstruction bottleneck. We propose representation grounding that uses a frozen pretrained vision foundation model to provide explicit per-patch representation guidance throughout denoising, allowing the pixel diffusion transformer to focusSep more on pixel generation. On ImageNet-256×256, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.46 after 600 epochs; at 512×512 21 resolution, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.48 after 680 epochs. [cs.CV]

Write only the summary.

PixelDiT2 introduces a novel end-to-end pixel-space diffusion model that decouples representation learning from pixel generation by leveraging a frozen pretrained vision foundation model to provide explicit per-patch representation guidance, thereby eliminating the need for an autoencoder or latent reconstruction bottleneck while achieving state-of-the-art image quality with FID scores of 1.46 on ImageNet-256×256 and 1.48 on ImageNet-512×512.

if capable techniques existed for personalizing an on-device LLM to a user’s medium-to-long-term
usage patterns, this would alleviate the scale-related challenges of mobile LLMs mentioned above.

On-device LLM personalization is an instance of ‘downstream’ LLM customization, whereby a LLM
is adapted to a novel task or user without adjusting the LLM’s parameters. There are two predominant
approaches. The first is parameter-efficient fine-tuning (‘PEFT’), which augments the LLM with
additional parameters and trains them such that the augmented LLM performs well for the given task
or user. An example in widespread use is low-rank adaptation (‘LoRA’) (Hu et al., 2021). The second
common approach to LLM customization is in-context learning (‘ICL’) (Brown et al., 2020), where
the LLM is provided with examples from the given task or user in its input sequence.

PEFT and ICL each have drawbacks, particularly when applied to on-device LLM personalization.
PEFT requires gradient descent to personalize a LoRA, a computationally prohibitive exercise on a
mobile device. ICL increases input sequence length and thus inference latency, which is typically
undesirable for interactive generative AI features. ICL also suffers worse quality as context length
grows4 (Liu et al., 2023; Li et al., 2024a). Considering that an LLM’s input sequence will also serve
other uses (e.g., as a conversation record during multi-turn chatbot interaction), it may be preferable to
utilize alternative manners of personalizing the on-device LLM to its user’s long-term characteristics.

In this work we present just such an alternative form of personalization, via LoRA-generating
hypernetworks. Entirely on device, the hypernetwork takes representative examples of a user as input
and produces a personalized LoRA as output, which is then attached to the on-device LLM. Li

- This approach trains a hypernetwork to map user context tokens to a low-rank adaptation (LoRA), allowing each user to synthesize a personalized LoRA entirely on-device using only forward passes, which avoids the computationally prohibitive gradient descent required by traditional parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT).

- The architecture is optimized for mobile environments by requiring minimal additional storage, as it leverages the same LLM weights as the target model, and demonstrates superior performance on challenging long-form text generation tasks compared to ICL and PEFT baselines.

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing

  参数:

    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

你是一个AI研究助手,可以获取最新的arXiv计算机科学论文。你有以下工具可以使用：

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1

  参数:

    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

- get_recently_submitted_cs_papers: 获取最近提交的计算机科学领域论文列表，支持按子领域筛选
  参数:
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 50
    aspect (string): 计算机科学子领域代码, 可选值: ['*', 'AI', 'AR']...等41个值
    days (integer): 查询最近多少天的论文, 默认: 7
    output_path (string): 可选：保存到指定文件路径；不传则用项目 output/recent_cs_papers.txt, 默认: 无默认值
    save_to_file (boolean): 是否将论文列表写入文件, 默认: True

- search_arxiv_papers: 按关键词、标题或作者检索 arXiv 论文，可选按提交时间过滤
  参数:
    query (string): 检索词；默认全字段检索，也可用 all:、ti: 或 au: 限定字段, 默认: 无默认值
    max_results (integer): 最大返回结果数, 默认: 10
    days (['integer', 'null']): 可选：只检索最近多少天内提交的论文, 默认: 无默认值

- download_arxiv_pdf: 根据 session 的短期记忆和 ref 下载 arXiv 论文 PDF，并维护 pdf_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): 会话ID，用于从短期记忆中解析 ref 或读取 last_active_paper_id, 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): 是否强制重新下载（覆盖本地文件）, 默认: False

- get_paper_content: Read deterministic text from a downloaded arXiv paper. Returns title + abstract by default, or a requested abstract/method/result/conclusion section.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    section (unknown): Optional section. When omitted, returns title + abstract according to the README T2 contract., 默认: None

- summarize_paper: Summarise a downloaded arXiv paper from its extracted text. Choose style (tldr/structured/bullet) and a max_words budget; the paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    style (string): Summary shape to produce., 可选值: ['tldr', 'structured', 'bullet']
    max_words (integer): Approximate word budget; values are rounded up to the nearest supported budget of 60, 120, 250., 默认: 120

- extract_paper_figures: Extract the embedded figures of a downloaded arXiv paper as image files, with page numbers and captions. The paper PDF must be downloaded first.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值

- analyze_figure: Answer a question about one figure of a downloaded arXiv paper. The paper's figures must be extracted first. Choose question (describe/axes/trend); the answer comes from the environment, not from you.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    figure_no (integer): 1-based index of the figure within the paper, in page order; 1 to 8., 默认: 1
    question (string): What to ask about the figure., 可选值: ['describe', 'axes', 'trend']

- translate_arxiv_pdf: 调用 pdf2zh 翻译 PDF 全文，默认只保留中文单语 mono PDF，并维护 translate_cache.json 索引（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    force (boolean): , 默认: False
    service (string): 翻译服务，如 bing/deepl/google, 默认: bing
    threads (integer): 线程数, 默认: 4
    keep_dual (boolean): 是否保留双语 PDF, 默认: False
    paper_id (string): 可选：直接指定 paper_id（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    pdf_url (string): 可选：直接指定 pdf_url（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值
    input_pdf_path (string): 可选：直接指定本地 PDF 路径（不依赖 session）, 默认: 无默认值

- get_paper_cache_status: 查询某篇论文的本地缓存状态(是否已下载raw、是否已翻译mono), 用于避免重复下载/翻译（ref 支持 null 指代最近操作论文）
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): 论文引用：1-based序号 或 arxiv id 或 title子串；也支持 null 表示最近一次操作的论文, 默认: 无默认值
    paper_id (string): , 默认: 无默认值

- get_translated_content: Read one page of a paper's Chinese translation (the PDF produced by translate_arxiv_pdf). The translation must be finished first. Returns the page text and the total page count.
  参数:
    session_id (string): , 默认: default
    ref (unknown): Paper reference: 1-based result index, arXiv id, or title fragment; null selects the most recently active paper., 默认: 无默认值
    page (integer): 1-based page of the translated PDF; page 1 usually holds the translated title and abstract., 默认: 1

The summary must be 3-5 bullet points, each starting with '- '.

Paper content:
Online Change-point Detection for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

Abstract
Abstract. Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) sys-2026 tems rely on past experience for learning coordinated behaviour, but this experience may become unreliable if the environment or task objective changes during training. In such cases, agents first need a way to recog-Sep nize that the situation has changed before deciding how to adapt. This 4 paper studies online change-point detection for cooperative MARL using reward-derived signals. We propose Patterns of Past Rewards (PPR), a lightweight algorithm-agnostic detector that smooths agents’ return streams, highlights recent changes, and applies a statistical drift detector to flag significant shifts. We evaluate PPR in a custom Speaker-Listener environment based on the Multi-Agent Particle Environment under two controlled non-stationarity scenarios. Our results show a trade-off be-[cs.MA] tween detection speed and alarm stability. A smoothed-return baseline detects earlier but produces many repeated alarms. In contrast, apply- ing the detector directly to raw returns often misses the shift. PPR of- fers a more balanced approach by limiting redundant detections while still identifying the controlled shifts. These findings highlight PPR as a lightweight, reward-based monitoring tool that enables cooperative MARL systems to reliably identify major changes during training.

Write only the summary.

- Addresses unreliable experience in cooperative MARL by detecting online environment or task changes.
- Proposes Patterns of Past Rewards (PPR), a lightweight, algorithm-agnostic detector using smoothed return streams.
- Employs statistical drift detection to flag significant shifts in reward-derived signals.
- Evaluated in a Speaker-Listener environment, PPR balances detection speed and alarm stability.
- Outperforms baselines by limiting redundant alarms while reliably identifying controlled non-stationarities.

You are building a paper-reading assistant. Read the arXiv paper content below and write a tldr summary in at most 120 words.

The summary must be a single sentence capturing the paper's core contribution.

Paper content:
Conformalized Quantile Regression and Minimax Limits of Fixed-Score Calibration under Known Covariate Shift

Abstract
In this paper, we study nonasymptotic Lp error bounds for interval length and conditional
coverage in split conformalized quantile regression (CQR). Our bounds rely on local regularity
conditions and accuracy guarantees for the estimated quantiles. We further instantiate our
bounds for quantile regression with sparse ReLU neural networks. We also consider covariate shift,
where the calibration and test covariates have different distributions, and derive nonasymptotic[math.ST] bounds for this setting. We obtain matching minimax upper and lower bounds in expectation
for two constructed fixed-score calibration benchmarks under known covariate shift. The bounds
match for every p ∈[1, ∞] in the scalar problem and for finite p in the K-threshold problem; for
the latter, a high-probability minimax lower bound holds for every p ∈[1, ∞].

Keywords: conformal prediction; quantile regression; covariate shift; finite-sample guarantees;
conditional coverage.

MSC2020 subject classifications: 62G08, 62G15, 62C20.

Write only the summary.

This paper establishes nonasymptotic $L_p$ error bounds for interval length and conditional coverage in split conformalized quantile regression under local regularity conditions, extending these guarantees to sparse ReLU neural networks and covariate shift settings, while proving matching minimax upper and lower bounds for fixed-score calibration benchmarks under known covariate shift.

Paper content:
DualWAM: Dual-System World Action Models for Asynchronous Global Planning and Local Refinement

Abstract
World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate robot actions and predict future world states, transferring priors2026 from video pretraining to robot control. However, future visual prediction is computationally expensive, so existing WAMs often rely on long action chunks to amortize inference cost across control steps, at the cost of closed-loop responsiveness.Sep We present DualWAM, a dual-system WAM that preserves broader-horizon world-action generation while 21 enablingperiodicallyhigh-frequencyperforms high-noiseclosed-loopbidirectionalaction updatesdenoisingby decouplingover a broaderglobal world-actionplanning andchunklocal refinement.to establishSystema global2 plan, while wrist-only System 1 extracts a temporally aligned short window from the intermediate denoising state and completes low-noise refinement using the latest wrist observations, which provide action-aligned cues about local geometry, motion, and contact during interaction. The two systems operate asynchronously along a shared denoising trajectory: each global plan is reused across multiple local updates, while System 1 repeatedly incorporates fresh interaction feedback. Across zero-shot manipulation tasks on Franka and Galbot, DualWAM improves success over the strongest[cs.RO] evaluated baseline by 4.5 percentage points on average, while achieving a 16.6× critical-path speedup. Further studies show that role-matched egocentric and UMI data improve success by 14 percentage points, and that the decoupled design naturally supports edge–cloud deployment with substantially lower communication overhead than the baseline. arXiv:2609.24868v1

Write only the summary.

## Problem and Motivation
World Action Models (WAMs) integrate robot action generation with future state prediction, leveraging video pretraining priors for control. However, the high computational cost of visual prediction forces existing WAMs to use long action chunks to amortize inference costs. This approach compromises closed-loop responsiveness, as the robot cannot frequently update its actions based on real-time feedback, leading to reduced adaptability in dynamic manipulation tasks.

## Methodology
DualWAM introduces a dual-system architecture that decouples global planning from local refinement. System 2 performs high-noise denoising to establish a broad-horizon global plan. Simultaneously, System 1 extracts a temporally aligned short window from the intermediate denoising state to perform low-noise refinement. This local system utilizes the latest wrist-only observations, which provide critical cues about local geometry, motion, and contact. The two systems operate asynchronously along a shared denoising trajectory; the global plan is reused across multiple local updates, while System 1 continuously incorporates fresh interaction feedback to ensure high-frequency, responsive control.

## Results and Deployment
On zero-shot manipulation tasks using Franka and Galbot robots, DualWAM outperforms the strongest baseline by an average of 4.5 percentage points in success rate. Crucially, it achieves a 16.6× critical-path speedup, significantly enhancing real-time performance. The study also demonstrates that using role-matched egocentric and UMI data further boosts success rates by 14 percentage points.

## Implications
The decoupled design of DualWAM naturally supports edge–cloud deployment architectures. By separating computationally intensive global planning from lightweight local refinement, the system substantially reduces communication overhead compared to baselines. This makes it a viable solution for scalable, responsive robotic control in complex environments.
